description: Player UX Fixes & Login Branding - Bidirectional bet slip entry, custom keypad consistency, success copy update, summary layout fix, and branded login screen

userStories.title: Update submission success copy
userStories.description: As a player, I want the success screen to confirm my bet was placed, not make it sound like a pending request.
acceptanceCriteria: Success screen title changed from 'Request Submitted!' to 'Bet Placed!' in BetSlipSheet.swift line 1145
Success screen subtitle changed from 'X bet(s) recorded and pending review' to 'X bet(s) placed successfully' at line 1150
No other success screen behavior changes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Smallest change, no dependencies. File: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift

userStories.title: Redesign numeric keypad to 4x3 grid with backspace bottom-right
userStories.description: As a player, I want a clean 4x3 keypad layout so number entry feels natural.
acceptanceCriteria: Backspace (⌫) is in the bottom-right cell of the grid
Keypad styling matches existing Theme (elevatedBackground buttons, textPrimary text, accent highlights)
Existing functionality preserved: text binding updates on tap, backspace deletes last character
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Prerequisite for US-003 and US-004. File: Booki/Views/NumericKeypadView.swift

userStories.title: Move quick stake buttons above keypad with Done button
userStories.description: As a player, I want quick stake buttons (+$5, +$10, +$25, +$50) accessible above the keypad for both singles and parlay modes.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick stake buttons appear in a horizontal row above the NumericKeypadView, inline with the 'Done' button (Done on right, quick stakes on left)
Quick stake buttons show whenever the keypad is visible, regardless of singles or parlay mode
Tapping a quick stake button adds that amount to the currently active field's wager value and recalculates the corresponding to-win
Remove QuickStakeRow from parlayStakeEntrySection (around line 844) since it moves into the keypad area
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002 (keypad redesign). Files: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift (stickyBottomSection lines 496-575, parlayStakeEntrySection lines 843-852)

userStories.title: Move payout summary from sticky bottom into scrollable area
userStories.description: As a player, I want to see my bet selections while the keypad is open instead of the summary blocking them.
acceptanceCriteria: Remove payoutSummarySection from stickyBottomSection parlay case (around line 511)
Remove singlesSummarySection from stickyBottomSection singles case (around line 533)
For parlay mode: payoutSummarySection appears in the ScrollView below parlayStakeEntrySection
For singles mode: singlesSummarySection appears in the ScrollView below all PremiumBetSlipItemCards
Sticky bottom section only contains: validation warnings, quick stakes + keypad (when active), and Place Bet button
Bet selections remain scrollable and visible when the keypad is showing
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-003 (keypad area has quick stakes). File: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift (stickyBottomSection lines 496-575, main body lines 400-490)

userStories.title: Convert parlay stake entry to custom numeric keypad
userStories.description: As a player, I want the parlay wager and to-win fields to use the custom keypad instead of the system keyboard for a consistent experience.
acceptanceCriteria: Parlay Wager field is a tappable Text view (not TextField) that sets activeFieldId to 'parlay_wager' on tap
Parlay To Win field is a tappable Text view (not TextField) that sets activeFieldId to 'parlay_towin' on tap
Tapping either field shows the NumericKeypadView in the sticky bottom section
Typing on the keypad updates the active field text and recalculates the other field bidirectionally using existing calculateToWin() and calculateWagerFromToWin() methods
Active field has glowing border via .glowingBorder() modifier (gold for Wager, cyan for To Win)
Remove @FocusState variables isParlayWagerFocused and isParlayToWinFocused (lines 63-66) since system keyboard is no longer used
Update activeKeypadBinding computed property (around line 1481) to handle 'parlay_wager' and 'parlay_towin' field IDs
No system keyboard appears when interacting with parlay stake fields
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-002/US-003 (keypad redesign). File: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift (parlayStakeEntrySection lines 733-852, activeKeypadBinding around line 1481)

userStories.title: Add bidirectional to-win entry on singles bet cards
userStories.description: As a player, I want to enter either a wager or a desired to-win amount on each singles bet card so I can work backwards from my desired payout.
acceptanceCriteria: Each PremiumBetSlipItemCard in singles mode shows side-by-side Wager and To Win fields (replacing the current single stake display + read-only To Win label)
Tapping the Wager field sets activeFieldId to the card's wager fieldId and opens the custom keypad
Tapping the To Win field sets activeFieldId to a new toWin fieldId (e.g. '{fieldId}_towin') and opens the custom keypad
Typing a wager amount recalculates To Win using BetSlipManager.calculateToWin(odds:stake:)
Typing a to-win amount recalculates Wager using BetSlipManager.calculateWagerFromToWin(odds:toWin:)
Active field has glowing border (gold for Wager, cyan for To Win) matching parlay styling
itemToWinTexts dictionary (already exists at BetSlipSheet line 44) stores per-item to-win text
Update activeKeypadBinding to handle singles to-win field IDs
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Depends on US-005 (parlay keypad pattern established). File: Booki/Views/BetSlipSheet.swift (PremiumBetSlipItemCard lines 1742-1792, activeKeypadBinding)

userStories.title: Branded teal login screen with Booki logo
userStories.description: As a player, I want the login screen to match the branded teal launch screen with the Booki logo so the app feels polished.
acceptanceCriteria: Login screen background uses teal Color(hex: 0x00F5D4) matching the launch screen and AuthGateView.loadingView
BookiLogo asset displayed prominently at top with 200pt width (same as loading screen)
Remove existing gradient background (Theme.backgroundGradient) and header icon (sportscourt.fill)
Email and password form fields use dark styling (Theme.background or Theme.cardBackground fill) that contrasts against teal background
Login button uses dark background (Theme.background) with light text to contrast teal
Sign Up and Claim Account navigation links remain visible and accessible
Apple Sign-In button remains functional and appropriately styled
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Independent of bet slip changes, last priority. File: Booki/Views/Auth/LoginView.swift
